findings.resolution: Typed execution results and exhaustive release-decision tests added.
Dashboard now presents evidence basis rather than probability.
Exact structured manifest coverage and two-reviewer approval are enforced.
Dashboard and canonical docs now distinguish deterministic stages and strategy foundations from planned model, live-tool, browser and execution verticals.

Every executed workflow stage now emits a bounded typed success, abstention or sanitized failure event and deliverable with capabilities, opaque evidence/artifact references, policy identity, measurements, gaps and next action.
Open vertical-slice boundaries are recorded in the retrospective ledger and remain FOUNDATION or NEXT rather than being presented as complete.
Canonical design now makes a deterministic graph context compiler the integration boundary for graph, lexical, semantic and historical evidence.
Roadmap now requires canonical relation classes with source-owned profile mappings and a renamed second-source fixture before portability is claimed.

Design and roadmap now identify current traversal as a foundation and require a canonical relation/endpoint propagation matrix, ordered path receipts, inverse/cycle/diamond tests and a separate versioned risk policy.
Scope and docs separate current trusted graph traversal from NEXT context compilation, semantic fusion, model-backed proposals and outcome memory.

A versioned policy-validated non-bypassable interlock now forces INCOMPLETE until explicit edge/path provenance, immutable release input, verified builds/obligations, scoped human approvals and deterministic conflict handling are implemented under a new reviewed schema. Service and API reads also revalidate historical decisions while repositories preserve the recorded audit fact.
The roadmap now separates the fail-closed analysis/demo sequence from production release-authority prerequisites, allowing graph-grounded reasoning work without weakening the interlock.
The required release-authority contract is represented as governance policy schema version 2.0.0 rather than retaining the prior major version.
